cards.intuition: Find the article-shaped DOM region and remove menus, banners, ads, and repeated chrome without losing warnings or code.

cards.intuition: Repeated navigation floods term statistics, creates duplicate chunks, and spends embeddings and prompt slots on site chrome.
A JavaScript shell is a failed extraction, not a short document. Render or use a content API only for sources needing it, under limits.
cards.formula: shell signal + low yield → fallback or quarantine

cards.intuition: Headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, code, links, and captions carry relationships that whitespace flattening destroys.
cards.formula: cleaning removes presentation noise, not semantic organization

cards.intuition: Tie clean output to URL, raw hash, fetch time, content type, extractor version, language, and source offsets.
cards.formula: raw artifact + extractor version → normalized content hash
cards.topic: HTML to Clean Text: Which Structure to Preserve

cards.intuition: Born-digital pages use their text layer plus layout reconstruction; scanned pages require rendering and OCR.
cards.formula: usable text layer ? layout parse : render + OCR
cards.topic: Extracting Text from PDFs and Office Documents

cards.intuition: DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX carry paragraphs, shapes, notes, cells, formulas, and hidden structure in XML packages, not one text stream.
cards.topic: Extracting Text from PDFs and Office Documents

cards.intuition: Treat files as hostile: isolate parsers, bound CPU and decompression, reject macros and external fetches, and sniff actual MIME.
cards.formula: sandbox + resource limits + no active content

cards.intuition: Judge yield, corruption, language, OCR confidence, repetition, structural coverage, page coverage, and parser warnings together.
cards.formula: quality record → accept, retry, quarantine, or discard

cards.intuition: Keep the source identity, reason, attempts, metrics, and decision so the artifact is not repeatedly reacquired and can be reprocessed later.
